name: Gruesome Slaughter
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Gruesome Slaughter (Combat)
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 150
You can inspire extreme revulsion when you slaughter your enemies.

Prerequisites: Intimidating Prowess, Killing Flourish, Intimidate 11 ranks, slayer level 11th.

Benefit: Creatures you demoralize by using the Killing Flourish feat must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + the higher of your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or become sickened for 1 minute.
Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
Source Pathfinder Unchained pg. 122
When using this feat, you can spend up to 5 stamina points to increase the DC of the effect by an amount equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
